checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is the curly-haired woman from the portrait
must.why: Same hair, sweater, park background; face remains very similar with natural expressions.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: Audio not transcribed. 5 s may be tight for the script.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth shapes change across frames (open, smile, small open), consistent with talking.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with audible friendly female English speech
must.why: Clip is 5 s, not 8 s. Square and has sound at -2.6 dB peak, but the 8 s duration is not met.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text; spoken audio could not be verified.

faults.what: Clip is 5 seconds, not the required 8 seconds; the full script may be rushed or cut off.
Expression is exaggerated versus the calm source portrait (wide eyebrows, big grin), slightly uncanny.
Head and framing shift slightly (zoom/position), minor drift.

summary: The clip is a convincing talking-head animation of the same woman with moving lips and no captions, but it runs 5 s instead of 8 s, and I could not verify the full script is spoken.
